title: Introducing the All-New Spyglass
summary: Experience the full power of Spyglass, now officially launched and out of beta, ready to elevate your workflow.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage, organize, and customize the visual presentation of all your embedded files directly within the editor, empowering you with greater creative control.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page provides a transparent and engaging way for you to explore what we've shipped, what's next, and what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes to be more intuitive, visually appealing, and easier to use, making your task management smoother than ever.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Tools
summary: Experience effortless teamwork with our enhanced collaboration features, designed to boost awareness and simplify working together.

title: Enhanced Sharing & Collaboration
summary: Effortlessly find and access all items shared with you, making collaborative work more integrated and productive.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: Enjoy Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for international languages, making our platform accessible to a global audience.

title: Noeko is Officially Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko is now open source, offering our community greater transparency, control, and opportunities for direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Our enhanced knowledge map empowers you to explore your ideas and connections more effectively through advanced filtering by tags and time, while also showcasing your shared content and collaborators.

title: Smart Search & Dynamic Collections
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your knowledge with powerful new filtering and sorting options, allowing you to save tailored searches as dynamic collections for instant access.

title: Flexible Content Views
summary: Customize how linked content appears within your notes with flexible new display modes, creating a more intuitive and interactive experience.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosted Freedom & Powerful Plans
summary: Get ready for Noeko's public debut, featuring seamless self-hostability and versatile premium plans to empower your projects.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Vibrant New Themes
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual upgrade with polished existing themes and an exciting collection of brand-new aesthetic options to personalize your experience.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Experience a more accurate and delightful welcome on your homepage with greetings that perfectly align with the time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Unlock powerful control over your tagged content with new direct actions that let you quickly unassign tags, delete items, or view details right from your tag lists.

title: Integrate More Content Types
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including websites, videos, and text files, to centralize all your valuable information for enhanced learning and analysis.
